risks.description: Automated migration that derives event IDs from alphabetical raw event codes could incorrectly create Orleans 事件M or collapse duplicate 事件N records.
risks.requiredMitigation: Use occurrence-qualified event shard paths and preserve rawEventCode exactly.

risks.description: Name-family matching may collapse distinct variants or presentations such as Jeanne/Jeanne Alter and Lion King/Saber Alter.
risks.requiredMitigation: Use explicit candidate decisions and source-backed distinct entity refs before migrating into curated data.

risks.description: Solomon source contains a large support cast represented by key fragments plus front relationship files, not exhaustive individual cameo fragments.
risks.requiredMitigation: Keep this as a known limitation and avoid treating absent cameo fragments as proof of absence.
